responsibility: Defines custom RTL operand predicates used by the PDP-11 machine description to recognize target-specific operand classes that generic predicates do not express cleanly. These predicates identify register-or-zero operands for tst-style patterns, the small immediate shift counts that should be expanded inline, +/-1 inc/dec immediates, FPU-only register forms for general and nonimmediate floating operands, and the subset of comparison operators valid for CCNZmode, giving pdp11.md precise matching conditions for instruction selection and splitting.
